Config.Name: Bridge data
Config.Description: Keychain, GPG key, and login state. This folder is what keeps Bridge signed in across restarts.

Config.Name: IMAP
Config.Description: IMAP for other apps and bots. The image forwards this port to Bridge on 1143. Leave the bind address blank to publish on the LAN, or set 127.0.0.1 to keep it on this server.

Config.Name: SMTP
Config.Description: SMTP submission for other apps and bots. The image forwards this port to Bridge on 1025. The same bind address rules as IMAP.
